extends Node
## The automated check for the tutorial at the camp and the campers' cones and search
## (camp_tutorial.gd, camp_person.gd, vision_cone.gd), made on 26 Oct 2026. It puts the
## raccoon in plain sight at the camp and checks:
##   - before the tutorial: no cones, nobody sees him, only the music's task on the list;
##   - the tutorial: the game pauses with a note to press Tab, Esc doesn't unpause it,
##     Tab brings up THE PLAN with Rock the party and its sub-tasks, Tab again carries on;
##     since 7 Nov 2026, when the tutorial was remade (camp_tutorial.gd), the game slows
##     down behind a dark layer instead of pausing, Tab brings up the TO DO list with the
##     marshmallows marked to start with, and Enter picks them and carries on. The guide's
##     steps after the pick are turned off here (`guide`), so the cones come on at the pick;
##   - once he's spotted: the spotter's cone red and every cone shown for the red and its
##     fade, then none; the chase and the shoo as before;
##   - once he's got away: each of them confused ("?", SEARCH) for SEARCH_TIME, then
##     walking back, their cone back BACK_AFTER seconds after they start;
##   - Rock the party ticked off once its sub-tasks are.
## Durations are measured on the camp's clock, so they're the same at any frame rate
## (run it with --fixed-fps 30, 60 and 144). Run it headless from the project folder:
##   godot --headless --path . -- --cones-test
## It prints a table and quits with exit code 0 if every check passes, 1 if not. Run it
## in a window with `--cones-shots=<folder>` as well, and it saves pictures.

const CampPerson := preload("res://scripts/camp_person.gd")
const Campsite := preload("res://scripts/campsite.gd")
const VisionCone := preload("res://scripts/vision_cone.gd")
const CampTutorial := preload("res://scripts/camp_tutorial.gd")
const S := CampPerson.State
## How far a measured time may be off: a physics tick, and a frame at 30 fps.
const SLACK := 1.0 / 60.0 + 1.0 / 30.0

## Set by the level (main.gd).
var level: Node
var shots := ""

var _t := 0.0
var _steps: Array = []
var _results: Array[Array] = []
var _failed := false
var _camp: Campsite
var _people: Array[CampPerson] = []
var _camper: CampPerson
var _player: Node3D
var _tasks
var _plan
var _tutorial: CampTutorial
## What happened, frame by frame, from the first spotting on (camp clock).
var _spot := -INF
var _all_shown_in_red := true
var _spotter_red_in_red := true
var _others_red := false
var _gone_at := INF
var _shown_while_alarmed := false
## Through the red: how far off the ground the cones were drawn at most, and how long the
## camper's was.
var _off_ground := 0.0
var _red_length := 0.0
var _search_from := {}
var _search_took := {}
var _return_at := {}
var _back_at := {}
var _seen_states := {}
var _shot_red := false
var _shot_search := false


func _ready() -> void:
	# The tutorial pauses the game: this has to go on through it.
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	_camp = level.campsite
	_camper = _camp.camper
	_people.assign([_camper, _camp.dancers[0], _camp.dancers[1]])
	_player = level.player
	_tasks = level.tasks
	_plan = level._plan
	_tutorial = level._tutorial
	# Its intro (the pan, the laugh, hiding) and its guide are off here: he arrives to
	# the dark layer and Tab at once (camp_tutorial.gd), as this check was made for.
	_tutorial.intro = false
	_tutorial.guide = false

	_at(0.5, func() -> void:
		_check("Before the tutorial: no cones", "false false false", _showing())
		_check("Before the tutorial: only the music's task on the list", "investigate", _shown_ids()))
	# In plain sight of the camper, 5 m in front of him, at the camp: the music's task
	# is done, and the tutorial starts a moment later.
	_at(0.6, func() -> void: _player.place(_in_view(_camper, 5.0)))
	_at(1.5, func() -> void:
		_check("Before the tutorial: in plain sight, nobody sees him", "false false false", _seeing())
		_check("Before the tutorial: nobody takes fright", "WORK WORK WORK", _states())
		_check("At the camp: the music's task is done", true, _tasks.is_done("investigate")))
	# (Since 7 Nov 2026 the game slows down here instead of pausing: these times are on
	# game time, so they come later on the clock on the wall.)
	_at(2.6, func() -> void:
		_check("Tutorial: the game slows right down behind a dark layer", true,
			Engine.time_scale <= CampTutorial.SLOW + 0.01 and _tutorial.spotlight.showing() and not get_tree().paused)
		_check("Tutorial: a note says to press Tab", CampTutorial.OPEN_NOTE, _plan.note_showing())
		_check("Tutorial: the TO DO list isn't up yet", false, _plan.open)
		_shot("01_tutorial_press_tab")
		_key(KEY_ESCAPE))
	_at(2.8, func() -> void:
		_check("Tutorial: Esc doesn't pause it or end it", true, _tutorial.running() and not get_tree().paused)
		_key(KEY_TAB))
	_at(3.4, func() -> void:
		_check("Tutorial: Tab brings up the TO DO list", true, _plan.open and _plan.up() >= 1.0)
		# Raid the bear bag joined the list on 10 Nov 2026 (camp_bear_bag.gd), and Pop the
		# balloons on 21 Nov 2026 (camp_balloons.gd; CHANGE-BRIEF.md's revision of that day).
		_check("Tutorial: the list shows Rock the party and its tasks",
			"investigate party marshmallows music cooler tent bearbag balloons", _shown_ids())
		_check("Tutorial: the note says to pick one, the marshmallows marked",
			CampTutorial.PICK_NOTE + " / marshmallows", _plan.note_showing() + " / " + _plan.highlighted())
		_check("Tutorial: still slowed down while he reads", true, Engine.time_scale <= CampTutorial.SLOW + 0.01)
		_check("Tutorial: still no cones", "false false false", _showing())
		_shot("02_tutorial_the_plan")
		_key(KEY_ENTER))
	_at(3.6, func() -> void:
		_check("Picked: the game's back to speed", 1.0, Engine.time_scale)
		_check("Picked: the list goes away", false, _plan.open)
		_check("Picked: the note goes", "", _plan.note_showing())
		_check("Picked: the cones are on", true, _camp.cones_on))
	# Standing there in plain sight, he's spotted at once.
	_at(4.5, func() -> void:
		_check("Spotted: the camper takes fright", true, S.STARTLED in _seen(_camper))
		_check("Spotted: the camp knows when", true, _spot > -INF))
	_at(7.0, func() -> void:
		_check("Spotted: the camper's cone red all through its red", true, _spotter_red_in_red)
		_check("Spotted: the other cones not red", false, _others_red)
		_check("Spotted: every cone shown through the red and its fade", true, _all_shown_in_red)
		_check("Spotted: every cone flat on the ground (within 8 cm)", true, _off_ground < 0.08)
		_check("Spotted: the red cone as long as when it caught him", "%.2f" % CampPerson.SIGHT, "%.2f" % _red_length)
		_check("Then every cone goes, RED_TIME + FADE_OUT after", "%.2f" % (VisionCone.RED_TIME + VisionCone.FADE_OUT),
			"%.2f" % _near(_gone_at - _spot, VisionCone.RED_TIME + VisionCone.FADE_OUT))
		_mark())
	# Lingering, he's chased and shooed, as before; then he's gone from the camp.
	_at(13.5, func() -> void:
		_check("Lingering: chased", true, S.CHASE in _seen(_camper) or S.CHASE in _seen(_people[1]))
		_check("Caught: shooed", true, S.SHOO in _seen(_camper) or S.SHOO in _seen(_people[1]))
		_check("While they're after him: no cones", false, _shown_while_alarmed)
		_send_away())
	_at(30.0, func() -> void:
		for person: CampPerson in _people:
			_check("Gone: the %s is confused (SEARCH) first" % _label(person), true, _search_took.has(person))
			_check("Gone: the %s looks about for SEARCH_TIME" % _label(person), "%.2f" % CampPerson.SEARCH_TIME,
				"%.2f" % _near(_search_took.get(person, -1.0), CampPerson.SEARCH_TIME))
		_check("While they search: still no cones", false, _shown_while_alarmed))
	_at(45.0, func() -> void:
		for person: CampPerson in _people:
			_check("Calm: the %s's cone back BACK_AFTER after starting back" % _label(person), "%.2f" % VisionCone.BACK_AFTER,
				"%.2f" % _near(_back_at.get(person, INF) - _return_at.get(person, -INF), VisionCone.BACK_AFTER))
		_check("Calm again: all three at their routines", "WORK WORK WORK", _states())
		_check("Calm again: the cones shown, and not red", "true true true / false false false",
			_showing() + " / " + " ".join(_people.map(func(p: CampPerson) -> String: return str(p.eyes.red()))))
		_shot_of(Vector3(Campsite.FIRE.x, 0.0, Campsite.FIRE.y), "05_cones_back")
		for id: String in ["marshmallows", "music"]:
			_tasks.done(id)
		_check("Two of its tasks done: Rock the party isn't", false, _tasks.is_done("party"))
		_tasks.done("cooler")
		# Dismantle the tent, added on 8 Nov 2026, is the fourth; Raid the bear bag, added on
		# 10 Nov 2026, the fifth.
		_tasks.done("tent")
		_tasks.done("bearbag")
		_check("All five done: Rock the party is ticked off", true, _tasks.is_done("party")))
	_at(45.5, _finish)


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	_t += delta
	if not get_tree().paused:
		_watch()
	while not _steps.is_empty() and _t >= _steps[0][0]:
		var step: Callable = _steps.pop_front()[1]
		step.call()


## Every frame of play: what the cones and the people are doing, on the camp's clock.
func _watch() -> void:
	var now: float = _camp.clock
	for person: CampPerson in _people:
		if not _seen_states.has(person):
			_seen_states[person] = {}
		_seen_states[person][person.state] = true
	if _spot == -INF and _camp.spotted_at > -INF:
		_spot = _camp.spotted_at
	if _spot == -INF:
		return
	var until: float = _spot + VisionCone.RED_TIME + VisionCone.FADE_OUT
	if now < until - 1e-4:
		_all_shown_in_red = _all_shown_in_red and _showing() == "true true true"
		# The cone counts its red from the frame it sees him, the camp from the frame
		# he's taken for spotted: through RED_TIME, both agree.
		if now < _spot + VisionCone.RED_TIME:
			_spotter_red_in_red = _spotter_red_in_red and _camper.eyes.red()
		_red_length = maxf(_red_length, _camper.eyes.drawn_length())
		for person: CampPerson in _people:
			# Red as drawn: the `alarm` cone_driver.gd gives its shader, 1 only on the
			# spotters' cones. Until 7 Nov 2026 this read the cone's own red(), which also
			# turns on when a camper who's already alarmed sees him; it passed only while
			# none of the others could see where he's put. In the bigger camp the girl,
			# frightened, turns and sees him, and her cone is still drawn yellow, as the
			# Assignment 5 rules say (tests/cone_shader_test.gd checks that case too).
			_others_red = _others_red or person != _camper and _drawn_alarm(person) > 0.0
			var box: AABB = person.eyes.drawn_box()
			_off_ground = maxf(_off_ground, maxf(absf(box.position.y), absf(box.end.y)))
		if not _shot_red and now > _spot + 0.5:
			_shot_red = true
			_shot("03_spotted_red")
	elif _gone_at == INF and _showing() == "false false false":
		_gone_at = now
	for person: CampPerson in _people:
		var alarmed: bool = not person.state in [S.WORK, S.RETURN, S.FIX, S.INVESTIGATE]
		if now >= until and alarmed and person.eyes.showing():
			_shown_while_alarmed = true
		if person.state == S.SEARCH and not _search_from.has(person):
			_search_from[person] = now
		if person == _camper and not _shot_search and _search_from.has(person) and now > _search_from[person] + 1.0:
			_shot_search = true
			_shot_of(_camper.global_position, "04_confused")
		if person.state == S.RETURN and _search_from.has(person) and not _return_at.has(person):
			_return_at[person] = now
			_search_took[person] = now - _search_from[person]
		if _return_at.has(person) and not _back_at.has(person) and person.eyes.showing():
			_back_at[person] = now


func _at(t: float, step: Callable) -> void:
	_steps.append([t, step])
	_steps.sort_custom(func(a: Array, b: Array) -> bool: return a[0] < b[0])


## Well out of the camp, where none of them can see him; once he's landed from the leap
## the shoo sent him on, which would carry him on from where he's put.
func _send_away() -> void:
	if _player.is_hopping():
		_at(_t + 0.1, _send_away)
	else:
		_player.place(Vector3(20.0, 0.02, 6.5))


## Presses and lets go of `keycode`, as a player would.
func _key(keycode: Key) -> void:
	for pressed: bool in [true, false]:
		var ev := InputEventKey.new()
		ev.keycode = keycode
		ev.physical_keycode = keycode
		ev.pressed = pressed
		Input.parse_input_event(ev)


## Forgets the states seen so far, so the next checks see only what happens after.
func _mark() -> void:
	_seen_states.clear()


func _seen(person: CampPerson) -> Array:
	return _seen_states.get(person, {}).keys()


## `measured` if it's within SLACK of `expected`, which then prints the same; else itself.
func _near(measured: float, expected: float) -> float:
	return expected if absf(measured - expected) <= SLACK else measured


func _label(person: CampPerson) -> String:
	return ["camper", "low-poly man", "girl"][_people.find(person)]


func _states() -> String:
	return " ".join(_people.map(func(p: CampPerson) -> String: return S.keys()[p.state]))


func _showing() -> String:
	return " ".join(_people.map(func(p: CampPerson) -> String: return str(p.eyes.showing())))


func _seeing() -> String:
	return " ".join(_people.map(func(p: CampPerson) -> String: return str(p.eyes.seeing)))


func _shown_ids() -> String:
	return " ".join(_tasks.shown().map(func(t: Dictionary) -> String: return t.id))


## `metres` in front of where `person`'s activity is done, on the ground, as near
## straight ahead as they can see it with nothing in the way, and out of the dancers'
## sight while they dance (as camp_test.gd).
func _in_view(person: CampPerson, metres: float) -> Vector3:
	var space := person.get_world_3d().direct_space_state
	var at := Vector3.ZERO
	for degrees: float in [0.0, -15.0, 15.0, -30.0, 30.0, -45.0, 45.0]:
		var yaw := person.activity_facing() + deg_to_rad(degrees)
		at = person.activity_spot() + Vector3(sin(yaw), 0, cos(yaw)) * metres + Vector3(0, 0.02, 0)
		var ray := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(person.eyes.global_position, at + Vector3.UP * 0.45, 1,
			[person.get_rid(), _player.get_rid()])
		var dancers_far := _people.slice(1).all(func(d: CampPerson) -> bool:
			return _flat(d.global_position - at).length() > CampPerson.SIGHT * CampPerson.DANCE_SIGHT + 0.3)
		if dancers_far and space.intersect_ray(ray).is_empty():
			return at
	return at


func _flat(v: Vector3) -> Vector3:
	return Vector3(v.x, 0.0, v.z)


func _shot(name: String) -> void:
	if shots == "" or DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
		return
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(shots)
	get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png(shots.path_join(name + ".png"))


## In a window, a picture with `at` in the middle rather than him, when he's away from
## the camp: the camera is held there for a frame (main.gd places it every frame).
## The `alarm` `person`'s cone is drawn with, 0 if it has no shader yet.
func _drawn_alarm(person: CampPerson) -> float:
	var m: ShaderMaterial = person.eyes.material()
	if m == null:
		return 0.0
	var v = m.get_shader_parameter("alarm")
	return 0.0 if v == null else float(v)


func _shot_of(at: Vector3, name: String) -> void:
	if shots == "" or DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
		return
	var camera: Camera3D = level.camera
	level.set_process(false)
	var depth := (_player.global_position - camera.global_position).dot(-camera.global_basis.z)
	camera.global_position = at + camera.global_basis.z * depth
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	_shot(name)
	level.set_process(true)


func _check(name: String, expected, actual) -> void:
	var ok: bool = str(expected) == str(actual)
	_failed = _failed or not ok
	_results.append([name, str(expected), str(actual), "pass" if ok else "FAIL"])


func _finish() -> void:
	print("")
	print("Tutorial and cones check, %s" % Time.get_datetime_string_from_system())
	for r: Array in _results:
		print("  %-4s  %-62s expected %-16s got %s" % [r[3], r[0], r[1], r[2]])
	print("RESULT: %s (%d checks)" % ["all checks passed" if not _failed else "SOME CHECKS FAILED", _results.size()])
	get_tree().quit(1 if _failed else 0)

extends Node
## The automated check for level 1's first puzzles (camp_puzzles.gd) and the campers'
## routines (camp_person.gd): it plays each task through E, as the player would (an E
## press goes through camp_input.gd), and checks what the campers make of it. Run it
## headless from the project folder:
##   godot --headless --path . --audio-driver Dummy -- --tasks-test
## It prints a table and quits with exit code 0 if every check passes, 1 if not. With
## `--tasks-shots=<folder>` in a window it saves a picture at each stage, and with
## `--tasks-debug` it prints each camper's every change of state as it goes.

const CampPerson := preload("res://scripts/camp_person.gd")
const Campsite := preload("res://scripts/campsite.gd")
const Forest := preload("res://scripts/forest.gd")
const ConeDriver := preload("res://scripts/cone_driver.gd")
const VisionCone := preload("res://scripts/vision_cone.gd")
const S := CampPerson.State
## Where he's put out of everyone's way.
const AWAY := Vector3(20.0, 0.02, 6.5)

## Set by the level (main.gd).
var level: Node
var shots := ""

var _results: Array[Array] = []
var _failed := false
var _camp: Campsite
var _puzzles: Node
var _camper: CampPerson
var _man: CampPerson
var _girl: CampPerson
var _player: Node3D
var _seen_states := {}
var _been_at := {}
var _debug := false
var _last_state := {}
var _frame := 0


func _ready() -> void:
	_camp = level.campsite
	_puzzles = _camp.puzzles
	_camper = _camp.camper
	_man = _camp.dancers[0]
	_girl = _camp.dancers[1]
	_player = level.player
	_debug = OS.get_cmdline_user_args().has("--tasks-debug")
	_run.call_deferred()


func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	_frame += 1
	for person: CampPerson in [_camper, _man, _girl]:
		if not _seen_states.has(person):
			_seen_states[person] = {}
		_seen_states[person][person.state] = true
		if not _been_at.has(person):
			_been_at[person] = {}
		if person.at_activity():
			_been_at[person][person.activity()] = true
		if _debug and _last_state.get(person, -1) != person.state:
			_last_state[person] = person.state
			print("%6.1f %-8s %-11s %-6s %s %s  him %s seeing %s" % [_camp.clock, person.name.left(8),
				S.keys()[person.state], person.activity(), person.at_activity(),
				person.global_position.snapped(Vector3.ONE * 0.01), _player.global_position.snapped(Vector3.ONE * 0.01),
				person.eyes.seeing])


func _run() -> void:
	await _wait(1.0)
	# Since 26 Oct 2026 the camp's three are the sub-tasks of one main task, Rock the party.
	# Dismantle the tent joined them on 8 Nov 2026 (camp_tent.gd), and Raid the bear bag on
	# 10 Nov 2026 (camp_bear_bag.gd).
	_check("The to-do list: the music, then Rock the party and its five",
		"investigate party marshmallows music cooler tent bearbag",
		" ".join(level.tasks.list.map(func(t: Dictionary) -> String: return t.id)))
	_check("Routines: the camper starts pegging out his tent", "peg", _camper.activity())
	_check("Routines: the low-poly man starts dancing", "dance", _man.activity())

	# Routines: each moves on to their next activity in turn, walking there.
	_camper._step_left = 0.01
	_man._step_left = 0.01
	_girl._step_left = 0.01
	await _wait(0.2)
	_check("Routines: each moves on to their next activity", "roast drink warm",
		" ".join([_camper.activity(), _man.activity(), _girl.activity()]))
	_check("Routines: walking there", "false false false",
		"%s %s %s" % [_camper.at_activity(), _man.at_activity(), _girl.at_activity()])
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _man.at_activity(), 10.0)
	await _wait(0.5)
	_check("Routines: the low-poly man gets to the cooler and opens it for a drink", true,
		_man.at_activity() and _man.activity() == "drink" and _puzzles._lid_open)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _man.activity() == "dance", 6.0)
	_check("Routines: drink done, he goes back to dancing", "dance", _man.activity())
	await _wait(0.1)
	_check("Routines: he shuts the cooler after him, unless he forgets", _puzzles._forgot, _puzzles._lid_open)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _camper.at_activity(), 15.0)
	_check("Routines: the camper sits roasting by the fire", true, _been_at[_camper].has("roast"))
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _been_at[_girl].has("warm"), 10.0)
	_check("Routines: the girl warms her hands at the fire", true, _been_at[_girl].has("warm"))
	if _girl.activity() == "warm":
		_girl._step_left = 0.01
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _girl.activity() == "dance" and _girl.at_activity(), 15.0)
	_check("Routines: and round again: she's back dancing", true, _girl.activity() == "dance" and _girl.at_activity())

	# Steal the marshmallows, caught: unzipped behind the roasting camper, then seen
	# with the bag; they snatch it back and the bag goes back in, zipped.
	await _settle([1, 0, 0])
	await _sneak_to(_backpack_front(), _puzzles._backpack.global_position)
	await _wait(0.3)
	_mark()
	await _press_e(Campsite.CampPuzzles.ZIP_TIME + 0.3)
	_check("Marshmallows: holding E unzips the backpack", true, _puzzles._unzipped)
	_check("Marshmallows: the bag tumbles out", true, _puzzles.bag.visible and _puzzles.bag.is_in_group("grabbable"))
	_check("Marshmallows: unzipped behind his back, unheard over the music", "WORK", S.keys()[_camper.state])
	await _press_e(0.0)
	await _wait(0.3)
	_check("Marshmallows: E picks the bag up", true, _player.held == _puzzles.bag)
	_mark()
	var by_fire := Vector3(Campsite.FIRE.x - 0.3, 0.02, Campsite.FIRE.y - 0.95)
	_stand(by_fire, _man.global_position)
	Input.action_release("sneak")
	await _until(func() -> bool: return S.TAKE in _seen(_camper) or S.TAKE in _seen(_man), 15.0)
	_check("Caught with the bag: a man snatches it back", true, S.TAKE in _seen(_camper) or S.TAKE in _seen(_man))
	_check("Caught with the bag: it's out of his mouth", false, _player.held == _puzzles.bag)
	await _wait(1.2)
	_shot("01_caught_with_the_bag_snatched_back_by-claude")
	# Since 8 Nov 2026 the bag's dropped and carried home before its puzzle resets, so the
	# check waits for that rather than a fixed 2.3 s; the expected values are the same.
	_player.place(AWAY)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return not _puzzles._unzipped, 20.0)
	_check("Caught: the backpack's zipped up again", false, _puzzles._unzipped)
	_check("Caught: the bag's back inside", false, _puzzles.bag.visible)
	_check("Caught: the task's still to do", false, level.tasks.is_done("marshmallows"))
	_player.place(AWAY)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _states() == "WORK WORK WORK", 30.0)
	_check("Calm again after the snatch", "WORK WORK WORK", _states())

	# Steal the marshmallows, clean: behind the roasting camper, then off home with it.
	await _settle([1, 0, 0])
	await _sneak_to(_backpack_front(), _puzzles._backpack.global_position)
	await _wait(0.3)
	_mark()
	await _press_e(Campsite.CampPuzzles.ZIP_TIME + 0.3, "02_unzipping_behind_his_back_by-claude")
	_shot("03_the_bag_tumbles_out_by-claude")
	await _press_e(0.0)
	await _wait(0.3)
	_check("Marshmallows again: the bag's in his mouth", true, _player.held == _puzzles.bag)
	_check("Marshmallows again: nobody noticed", "WORK WORK WORK", _states())
	Input.action_release("sneak")
	_player.place(Forest.HOME + Vector3(1.0, 0.02, 1.2))
	await _wait(0.3)
	await _press_e(0.0)
	await _wait(0.8)
	_check("Marshmallows: dropped in his stash, the task's done", true, level.tasks.is_done("marshmallows"))

	# Music off: tug the plug out, drag it off; everyone wonders, then the low-poly man
	# finds it and puts it back.
	await _settle([0, 0, 0])
	var socket: Vector3 = _puzzles._socket
	await _sneak_to(socket + Vector3(0.0, 0.02, 0.4), socket)
	await _wait(0.3)
	_mark()
	await _press_e(Campsite.CampPuzzles.PULL_TIME + 0.3)
	_check("Music off: the plug comes out in his mouth", true, _player.held == _puzzles.plug)
	_check("Music off: the music stops", false, _camp.music_on)
	_check("Music off: the speaker's quiet", false, _camp.party.playing)
	_check("Music off: the task's done", true, level.tasks.is_done("music"))
	_check("Music off: the dancers stop dead, mid-move", "0 0",
		"%d %d" % [_man.anim.speed_scale, _girl.anim.speed_scale])
	_shot("04_music_off_they_stop_dead_by-claude")
	_player.place(socket + Vector3(-1.6, 0.02, -0.8))
	await _wait(0.2)
	await _press_e(0.0)
	await _wait(0.3)
	_check("Music off: he drops the plug away from the socket", true, _player.held == null)
	_player.place(AWAY)
	await _wait(2.0)
	_check("Music off: frozen, they don't see him get away", false,
		S.STARTLED in _seen(_man) or S.STARTLED in _seen(_girl))
	_check("Music off: the dancers wonder what happened", true,
		S.INVESTIGATE in _seen(_man) and S.INVESTIGATE in _seen(_girl))
	await _until(func() -> bool: return S.FIX in _seen(_man), 20.0)
	_check("Music off: the low-poly man goes to put it back", true, S.FIX in _seen(_man))
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _camp.music_on, 30.0)
	_check("Music off: he plugs it back in and the music's on", true, _camp.music_on and _camp.party.playing)
	_check("Music off: the task stays done", true, level.tasks.is_done("music"))

	# Noise: the same clunk is lost in the music, and heard in the quiet.
	await _settle([0, 0, 0])
	_mark()
	var near_man: Vector3 = _man.global_position + Vector3(2.5, 0, 0)
	_camp.noise(near_man, Campsite.CampPuzzles.LID_NOISE)
	await _wait(0.5)
	_check("Noise: a clunk 2.5 m off, with the music on: unheard", false, S.INVESTIGATE in _seen(_man))
	_puzzles.music_on = false
	_camp.noise(near_man, Campsite.CampPuzzles.LID_NOISE)
	await _wait(0.5)
	_check("Noise: the same clunk with the music off: he wonders", true, S.INVESTIGATE in _seen(_man))
	_puzzles.music_on = true

	# Raid the cooler: nose the lid open while the camper's pegging his tent and the
	# others are dancing, lost in the music; take the sausages home.
	await _settle([0, 0, 0])
	if _puzzles._lid_open:
		# Left open after a drink: shut, so it's his to open.
		_puzzles._reset_cooler()
		await _wait(0.5)
	var cooler: Node3D = _puzzles.cooler
	await _sneak_to(cooler.global_position + cooler.global_basis.z * 0.45, cooler.global_position)
	await _wait(0.3)
	_mark()
	await _press_e(Campsite.CampPuzzles.LID_TIME + 0.3, "05_nosing_the_cooler_open_by-claude")
	await _wait(0.5)
	_check("Cooler: holding E noses the lid open", true, _puzzles._lid_open)
	_check("Cooler: the sausages can be reached", true, _puzzles.sausages.is_in_group("grabbable"))
	_shot("06_the_sausages_by-claude")
	await _press_e(0.0)
	await _wait(0.3)
	_check("Cooler: E takes the sausages", true, _player.held == _puzzles.sausages)
	_check("Cooler: nobody noticed", "WORK WORK WORK", _states())
	Input.action_release("sneak")
	_player.place(Forest.HOME + Vector3(-1.0, 0.02, 1.2))
	await _wait(0.3)
	await _press_e(0.0)
	await _wait(0.8)
	_check("Cooler: dropped in his stash, the task's done", true, level.tasks.is_done("cooler"))
	# The tent (8 Nov 2026) is played through in tent_test.gd, and the bear bag (10 Nov 2026)
	# in bear_bag_test.gd; here they're ticked off, so this still checks the list is done
	# once every task is.
	level.tasks.done("tent")
	level.tasks.done("bearbag")
	_check("All six tasks done", true, level.tasks.all_done())
	await _wait(1.0)
	_shot("07_loot_in_his_stash_all_ticked_by-claude")

	# Last, so the tasks above keep their own timing (the fire keeper, who isn't settled,
	# is where he always was at the cooler). His laugh (11 Nov 2026): heard HEAR_CHITTER
	# round, the music or not, and it turns those already wondering to where it came from.
	# Sneaking, out of the low-poly man's sight: 6.5 m behind him, further than other noises
	# carry with the music on.
	await _settle([0, 0, 0])
	Input.action_press("sneak")
	_mark()
	var behind: Vector3 = _man.global_position - _man.global_basis.z * 6.5
	_player.place(Vector3(behind.x, 0.02, behind.z))
	await _wait(0.1)
	_player.chitter()
	await _wait(0.1)
	_check("Laugh: 6.5 m behind him, the music on: he turns to it", "true true",
		"%s %s" % [_camp.music_on, S.INVESTIGATE in _seen(_man) and _man._noise_at.distance_to(_player.global_position) < 0.3])
	var side: Vector3 = _man.global_position + _man.global_basis.x * 6.0
	_player.place(Vector3(side.x, 0.02, side.z))
	_player.chitter()
	await get_tree().physics_frame
	_check("Laugh again from his side while he wonders: he turns to that one", "INVESTIGATE true",
		"%s %s" % [S.keys()[_man.state], _man._noise_at.distance_to(_player.global_position) < 0.3])
	_player.place(AWAY)
	Input.action_release("sneak")

	# His running and his landing from a jump (11 Nov 2026): heard HEAR_STEPS round, as his
	# laugh is, the music or not. 5.3 m behind the low-poly man, out of his sight: further
	# than his running was heard before (4 m). Run past by hand (as Shift and a key would),
	# or a jump on the spot.
	for how: String in ["Running", "A jump"]:
		await _settle([0, 0, 0])
		_mark()
		behind = _man.global_position - _man.global_basis.z * 5.3
		_player.place(Vector3(behind.x, 0.02, behind.z))
		_player.velocity = Vector3.ZERO
		await _wait(0.1)
		if how == "Running":
			_player.run_off(_man.global_basis.x, 0.5)
		else:
			_player.jump()
		await _until(func() -> bool: return S.INVESTIGATE in _seen(_man), 1.2)
		_check("%s 5.3 m behind him, the music on: he turns to it" % how, "true true",
			"%s %s" % [_camp.music_on, S.INVESTIGATE in _seen(_man)])
		_player.place(AWAY)

	# The cones and how he moves (11 Nov 2026): they show while he sneaks, fade while he
	# moves about upright, and stay as they were while he stands still. On the trail, out of
	# everyone's sight, read off the low-poly man's cone.
	await _settle([0, 0, 0])
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _man.eyes.showing(), 10.0)
	Input.action_press("move_right")
	await _wait(ConeDriver.STEALTH_OUT + 0.3)
	var walking := _cone_shown(_man)
	Input.action_release("move_right")
	await _wait(0.8)
	var stopped := _cone_shown(_man)
	Input.action_press("sneak")
	await _wait(VisionCone.FADE_OUT + 0.2)
	_check("Cones: walking upright they fade; stopped, they stay faded; sneaking, they're back", "true 0.00 0.00 1.00",
		"%s %.2f %.2f %.2f" % [_man.eyes.showing(), walking, stopped, _cone_shown(_man)])
	Input.action_release("sneak")

	for music in [level._music, level._sleep_music]:
		if music:
			music.stop()
	if _camp.party:
		_camp.party.stop()
	await _wait(0.3)
	_finish()


# --- Moves ---------------------------------------------------------------------

## Out of the way, everyone calm, then each at step `steps[i]` of their routine (the
## camper, the low-poly man, the girl), staying at it.
func _settle(steps: Array) -> void:
	Input.action_release("sneak")
	_player.place(AWAY)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _states() == "WORK WORK WORK", 40.0)
	var people: Array[CampPerson] = [_camper, _man, _girl]
	for i in people.size():
		if people[i]._step != steps[i]:
			people[i]._step = steps[i]
			people[i]._arrived = false
		people[i]._step_left = 400.0
	await _until(func() -> bool: return people.all(func(p: CampPerson) -> bool: return p.at_activity()), 30.0)
	await _wait(0.5)


func _backpack_front() -> Vector3:
	var pack: Node3D = _puzzles._backpack
	return pack.global_position + pack.global_basis.z * 0.42 + Vector3(0, 0.02, 0)


## Sneaking, put at `at` facing `look`. He's sneaking before he's put there, as he
## would be walking up.
func _sneak_to(at: Vector3, look: Vector3) -> void:
	Input.action_press("sneak")
	await get_tree().physics_frame
	await get_tree().physics_frame
	_stand(at, look)


func _stand(at: Vector3, look: Vector3) -> void:
	var d := look - at
	_player.global_basis = Basis(Vector3.UP, atan2(-d.x, -d.z))
	_player.place(at)


## E pressed (through the level's input, as a key would be), held `hold` seconds;
## with `shot`, a picture halfway through.
func _press_e(hold: float, shot := "") -> void:
	var down := InputEventAction.new()
	down.action = "grab"
	down.pressed = true
	Input.parse_input_event(down)
	if shot != "":
		await _wait(hold * 0.5)
		_shot(shot)
		await _wait(hold * 0.5)
	else:
		await _wait(maxf(hold, 0.05))
	var up := InputEventAction.new()
	up.action = "grab"
	up.pressed = false
	Input.parse_input_event(up)
	await _wait(0.05)


func _wait(seconds: float) -> void:
	await get_tree().create_timer(seconds, true, true).timeout


func _until(done: Callable, timeout: float) -> void:
	var left := timeout
	while left > 0.0 and not done.call():
		await get_tree().physics_frame
		left -= get_physics_process_delta_time()


func _mark() -> void:
	_seen_states.clear()


## How much of `person`'s cone shows (the cone shader's `shown`, as cone_driver.gd sets it).
func _cone_shown(person: CampPerson) -> float:
	return person.eyes.material().get_shader_parameter("shown")


func _seen(person: CampPerson) -> Array:
	return _seen_states.get(person, {}).keys()


func _states() -> String:
	return " ".join([_camper, _man, _girl].map(func(p: CampPerson) -> String: return S.keys()[p.state]))


func _check(name: String, expected, actual) -> void:
	var ok: bool = str(expected) == str(actual)
	_failed = _failed or not ok
	_results.append([name, str(expected), str(actual), "pass" if ok else "FAIL"])


func _shot(name: String) -> void:
	if shots == "" or DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
		return
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(shots)
	get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png(shots.path_join(name + ".png"))


func _finish() -> void:
	print("")
	print("Camp tasks check, %s" % Time.get_datetime_string_from_system())
	for r: Array in _results:
		print("  %-4s  %-66s expected %-16s got %s" % [r[3], r[0], r[1], r[2]])
	print("RESULT: %s (%d checks)" % ["all checks passed" if not _failed else "SOME CHECKS FAILED", _results.size()])
	get_tree().quit(1 if _failed else 0)

extends Node
## The automated check for level 1's first puzzles (camp_puzzles.gd) and the campers'
## routines (camp_person.gd): it plays each task through E, as the player would (an E
## press goes through camp_input.gd), and checks what the campers make of it. Run it
## headless from the project folder:
##   godot --headless --path . --audio-driver Dummy -- --tasks-test
## It prints a table and quits with exit code 0 if every check passes, 1 if not. With
## `--tasks-shots=<folder>` in a window it saves a picture at each stage, and with
## `--tasks-debug` it prints each camper's every change of state as it goes.

const CampPerson := preload("res://scripts/camp_person.gd")
const Campsite := preload("res://scripts/campsite.gd")
const Forest := preload("res://scripts/forest.gd")
const ConeDriver := preload("res://scripts/cone_driver.gd")
const VisionCone := preload("res://scripts/vision_cone.gd")
const S := CampPerson.State
## Where he's put out of everyone's way.
const AWAY := Vector3(20.0, 0.02, 6.5)

## Set by the level (main.gd).
var level: Node
var shots := ""

var _results: Array[Array] = []
var _failed := false
var _camp: Campsite
var _puzzles: Node
var _camper: CampPerson
var _man: CampPerson
var _girl: CampPerson
var _player: Node3D
var _seen_states := {}
var _been_at := {}
var _debug := false
var _last_state := {}
var _frame := 0


func _ready() -> void:
	_camp = level.campsite
	_puzzles = _camp.puzzles
	_camper = _camp.camper
	_man = _camp.dancers[0]
	_girl = _camp.dancers[1]
	_player = level.player
	_debug = OS.get_cmdline_user_args().has("--tasks-debug")
	_run.call_deferred()


func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	_frame += 1
	for person: CampPerson in [_camper, _man, _girl]:
		if not _seen_states.has(person):
			_seen_states[person] = {}
		_seen_states[person][person.state] = true
		if not _been_at.has(person):
			_been_at[person] = {}
		if person.at_activity():
			_been_at[person][person.activity()] = true
		if _debug and _last_state.get(person, -1) != person.state:
			_last_state[person] = person.state
			print("%6.1f %-8s %-11s %-6s %s %s  him %s seeing %s" % [_camp.clock, person.name.left(8),
				S.keys()[person.state], person.activity(), person.at_activity(),
				person.global_position.snapped(Vector3.ONE * 0.01), _player.global_position.snapped(Vector3.ONE * 0.01),
				person.eyes.seeing])


func _run() -> void:
	await _wait(1.0)
	# Since 26 Oct 2026 the camp's three are the sub-tasks of one main task, Rock the party.
	# Dismantle the tent joined them on 8 Nov 2026 (camp_tent.gd), Raid the bear bag on
	# 10 Nov 2026 (camp_bear_bag.gd), and Pop the balloons on 21 Nov 2026 (camp_balloons.gd).
	_check("The to-do list: the music, then Rock the party and its six",
		"investigate party marshmallows music cooler tent bearbag balloons",
		" ".join(level.tasks.list.map(func(t: Dictionary) -> String: return t.id)))
	_check("Routines: the camper starts pegging out his tent", "peg", _camper.activity())
	_check("Routines: the low-poly man starts dancing", "dance", _man.activity())

	# Routines: each moves on to their next activity in turn, walking there.
	_camper._step_left = 0.01
	_man._step_left = 0.01
	_girl._step_left = 0.01
	await _wait(0.2)
	_check("Routines: each moves on to their next activity", "roast drink warm",
		" ".join([_camper.activity(), _man.activity(), _girl.activity()]))
	_check("Routines: walking there", "false false false",
		"%s %s %s" % [_camper.at_activity(), _man.at_activity(), _girl.at_activity()])
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _man.at_activity(), 10.0)
	await _wait(0.5)
	_check("Routines: the low-poly man gets to the cooler and opens it for a drink", true,
		_man.at_activity() and _man.activity() == "drink" and _puzzles._lid_open)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _man.activity() == "dance", 6.0)
	_check("Routines: drink done, he goes back to dancing", "dance", _man.activity())
	await _wait(0.1)
	_check("Routines: he shuts the cooler after him, unless he forgets", _puzzles._forgot, _puzzles._lid_open)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _camper.at_activity(), 15.0)
	_check("Routines: the camper sits roasting by the fire", true, _been_at[_camper].has("roast"))
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _been_at[_girl].has("warm"), 10.0)
	_check("Routines: the girl warms her hands at the fire", true, _been_at[_girl].has("warm"))
	if _girl.activity() == "warm":
		_girl._step_left = 0.01
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _girl.activity() == "dance" and _girl.at_activity(), 15.0)
	_check("Routines: and round again: she's back dancing", true, _girl.activity() == "dance" and _girl.at_activity())

	_mark()
	await _press_e(Campsite.CampPuzzles.ZIP_TIME + 0.3)

	_check("Marshmallows: the bag tumbles out", true, _puzzles.bag.visible and _puzzles.bag.is_in_group("grabbable"))
	_check("Marshmallows: unzipped behind his back, unheard over the music", "WORK", S.keys()[_camper.state])
	await _press_e(0.0)
	await _wait(0.3)
	_check("Marshmallows: E picks the bag up", true, _player.held == _puzzles.bag)

	_check("Caught: the bag's back inside", false, _puzzles.bag.visible)
	_check("Caught: the task's still to do", false, level.tasks.is_done("marshmallows"))

	await _press_e(0.0)
	await _wait(0.3)

	await _settle([0, 0, 0])
	var socket: Vector3 = _puzzles._socket
	await _sneak_to(socket + Vector3(0.0, 0.02, 0.4), socket)
	await _wait(0.3)
	_mark()
	await _press_e(Campsite.CampPuzzles.PULL_TIME + 0.3)

	_check("Music off: the music stops", false, _camp.music_on)
	_check("Music off: the speaker's quiet", false, _camp.party.playing)
	_check("Music off: the task's done", true, level.tasks.is_done("music"))
	_check("Music off: the dancers stop dead, mid-move", "0 0",

	_player.place(socket + Vector3(-1.6, 0.02, -0.8))
	await _wait(0.2)
	await _press_e(0.0)

	await _press_e(0.0)

	_check("Cooler: E takes the sausages", true, _player.held == _puzzles.sausages)
	_check("Cooler: nobody noticed", "WORK WORK WORK", _states())

	_shot("07_loot_in_his_stash_all_ticked_by-claude")

	_mark()
	var behind: Vector3 = _man.global_position - _man.global_basis.z * 6.5
	_player.place(Vector3(behind.x, 0.02, behind.z))
	await _wait(0.1)
	_player.chitter()
	await _wait(0.1)
	_check("Laugh: 6.5 m behind him, the music on: he turns to it", "true true",
		"%s %s" % [_camp.music_on, S.INVESTIGATE in _seen(_man) and _man._noise_at.distance_to(_player.global_position) < 0.3])
	var side: Vector3 = _man.global_position + _man.global_basis.x * 6.0
	_player.place(Vector3(side.x, 0.02, side.z))
	_player.chitter()
	await get_tree().physics_frame
	_check("Laugh again from his side while he wonders: he turns to that one", "INVESTIGATE true",
		"%s %s" % [S.keys()[_man.state], _man._noise_at.distance_to(_player.global_position) < 0.3])
	_player.place(AWAY)
	Input.action_release("sneak")

	# than his running was heard before (4 m). Run past by hand (as Shift and a key would),

	# everyone's sight, read off the low-poly man's cone.

		"%s %.2f %.2f %.2f" % [_man.eyes.showing(), walking, stopped, _cone_shown(_man)])

		_camp.party.stop()
	await _wait(0.3)
	_finish()


# --- Moves ---------------------------------------------------------------------

## Out of the way, everyone calm, then each at step `steps[i]` of their routine (the
## camper, the low-poly man, the girl), staying at it.
func _settle(steps: Array) -> void:
	Input.action_release("sneak")
	_player.place(AWAY)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _states() == "WORK WORK WORK", 40.0)
	var people: Array[CampPerson] = [_camper, _man, _girl]
	for i in people.size():
		if people[i]._step != steps[i]:
			people[i]._step = steps[i]
			people[i]._arrived = false
		people[i]._step_left = 400.0
	await _until(func() -> bool: return people.all(func(p: CampPerson) -> bool: return p.at_activity()), 30.0)
	await _wait(0.5)


func _backpack_front() -> Vector3:
	var pack: Node3D = _puzzles._backpack
	return pack.global_position + pack.global_basis.z * 0.42 + Vector3(0, 0.02, 0)


## Sneaking, put at `at` facing `look`. He's sneaking before he's put there, as he
## would be walking up.
func _sneak_to(at: Vector3, look: Vector3) -> void:
	Input.action_press("sneak")
	await get_tree().physics_frame
	await get_tree().physics_frame
	_stand(at, look)


func _stand(at: Vector3, look: Vector3) -> void:
	var d := look - at
	_player.global_basis = Basis(Vector3.UP, atan2(-d.x, -d.z))
	_player.place(at)


## E pressed (through the level's input, as a key would be), held `hold` seconds;
## with `shot`, a picture halfway through.
func _press_e(hold: float, shot := "") -> void:
	var down := InputEventAction.new()
	down.action = "grab"
	down.pressed = true
	Input.parse_input_event(down)
	if shot != "":
		await _wait(hold * 0.5)
		_shot(shot)
		await _wait(hold * 0.5)
	else:
		await _wait(maxf(hold, 0.05))
	var up := InputEventAction.new()
	up.action = "grab"
	up.pressed = false
	Input.parse_input_event(up)
	await _wait(0.05)


func _wait(seconds: float) -> void:
	await get_tree().create_timer(seconds, true, true).timeout


func _until(done: Callable, timeout: float) -> void:
	var left := timeout
	while left > 0.0 and not done.call():
		await get_tree().physics_frame
		left -= get_physics_process_delta_time()


func _mark() -> void:
	_seen_states.clear()


## How much of `person`'s cone shows (the cone shader's `shown`, as cone_driver.gd sets it).
func _cone_shown(person: CampPerson) -> float:
	return person.eyes.material().get_shader_parameter("shown")


func _seen(person: CampPerson) -> Array:
	return _seen_states.get(person, {}).keys()


func _states() -> String:
	return " ".join([_camper, _man, _girl].map(func(p: CampPerson) -> String: return S.keys()[p.state]))


func _check(name: String, expected, actual) -> void:
	var ok: bool = str(expected) == str(actual)
	_failed = _failed or not ok
	_results.append([name, str(expected), str(actual), "pass" if ok else "FAIL"])


func _shot(name: String) -> void:
	if shots == "" or DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
		return
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(shots)
	get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png(shots.path_join(name + ".png"))


func _finish() -> void:
	print("")
	print("Camp tasks check, %s" % Time.get_datetime_string_from_system())
	for r: Array in _results:
		print("  %-4s  %-66s expected %-16s got %s" % [r[3], r[0], r[1], r[2]])
	print("RESULT: %s (%d checks)" % ["all checks passed" if not _failed else "SOME CHECKS FAILED", _results.size()])
	get_tree().quit(1 if _failed else 0)

extends Node
## The automated check for the tutorial at the camp (camp_tutorial.gd) as remade on
## 7 Nov 2026, all of it on: it plays it through as a player would, with Tab and E going
## through the level's input, and checks each step:
##   - the pan: the game slowed behind the dark layer, the camera on the campers with a
##     word or two;
##   - the laugh: back on him, he chitters, the cones come on, and someone comes to look;
##   - hide: the campers frozen and the bush lit till he's in it; then they carry on, the
##     ones who saw him confused where they stand, nobody coming for him;
##   - lost: the camera on the one who saw him, confused; chased right to the bush (set
##     going by the check), they can't catch him in it; all back at work, the roasting
##     starts, with a note to sneak out, and a move key hops him out, sneaking;
##   - the plate: the first roasted marshmallow on it, the campers frozen, the plate lit,
##     no words, the raccoon hungry; he takes it with E; they come to, alerted, and the
##     men chase him; E doesn't drop it, and he can't eat it yet;
##   - away, once they're all back at work: the E over him; holding it, he sits up and
##     eats it from his paws, held still, and nobody notices; "Yum!";
##   - Tab: the TO DO list up to read, the game slowed; Tab again, and the world's open:
##     no notes, full speed, and he can move.
## Run it headless from the project folder:
##   bash scripts/run-test.sh --tutorial-test 60
## It prints a table and quits with exit code 0 if every check passes, 1 if not. With
## `--tutorial-shots=<folder>` in a window it saves a picture at each stage.

const CampPerson := preload("res://scripts/camp_person.gd")
const Campsite := preload("res://scripts/campsite.gd")
const CampTutorial := preload("res://scripts/camp_tutorial.gd")
const RoastPlate := preload("res://scripts/roast_plate.gd")
const HideSpot := preload("res://scripts/hide_spot.gd")
const Forest := preload("res://scripts/forest.gd")
const S := CampPerson.State
## Where he's put out of everyone's way (as tasks_test.gd).
const AWAY := Vector3(20.0, 0.02, 6.5)

## Set by the level (main.gd).
var level: Node
var shots := ""

var _results: Array[Array] = []
var _failed := false
var _camp: Campsite
var _puzzles: Node
var _tutorial: CampTutorial
var _plan
var _player: Node3D


func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	_camp = level.campsite
	_puzzles = _camp.puzzles
	_tutorial = level._tutorial
	_plan = level._plan
	_player = level.player
	_run.call_deferred()


func _run() -> void:
	await _wait(0.5)
	_check("Before the camp: no cones, no dark layer", "false false", "%s %s" % [_camp.cones_on, _tutorial.spotlight.showing()])

	# Into the clearing on its west side, by the bush, where he sees the party.
	_player.place(Vector3(Campsite.FIRE.x - 5.0, 0.02, Campsite.FIRE.y + 2.0))
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _tutorial.step == CampTutorial.Step.INTRO, 10.0)
	await _real(0.8)
	_shot("01_pan")
	# Since 8 Nov 2026 the pan is a slow glide round the camp with no words (the author).
	_check("The pan: slowed, the camera panning, no words", "true true ",
		"%s %s %s" % [Engine.time_scale <= CampTutorial.SLOW + 0.01, level.camera_focus != null, _tutorial.spotlight.line()])
	_check("The pan: he's held still, and no cones", "true false", "%s %s" % [_player.input_locked, _camp.cones_on])

	await _until_real(func() -> bool: return _tutorial.stage == "seen", 10.0)
	_check("The laugh: back on him, he laughs, the cones on", "true true true",
		"%s %s %s" % [level.camera_focus == null, _tutorial._laughed_at > -INF, _camp.cones_on])
	_check("The laugh: someone comes to look", true, _camp.people.any(func(p) -> bool: return p.state != S.WORK))

	await _until(func() -> bool: return _tutorial.stage == "hide", 8.0)
	await _real(0.5)
	_shot("02_hide")
	_check("Seen: the campers frozen, the bush lit, 'Hide!'", "true true %s" % CampTutorial.HIDE_LINE,
		"%s %s %s" % [_tutorial.frozen(), _camp.people.all(func(p) -> bool: return p.process_mode == Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED),
			_tutorial.spotlight.line()])
	_check("Seen: full speed, he can move, a note to hide", "%s false %s" % [1.0, CampTutorial.HIDE_NOTE],
		"%s %s %s" % [Engine.time_scale, _player.input_locked, _plan.note_showing()])
	await _wait(1.0)
	_check("Held: it waits for him to hide", "hide true", "%s %s" % [_tutorial.stage, _tutorial.frozen()])

	# Into the bush. Whoever saw him or took fright is confused where they stand; nobody
	# comes for him (the author: "dont let the npcs run to him").
	# Tending the fire (the keeper, through the tutorial since 8 Nov 2026) isn't alarm.
	var alarmed: Array = _camp.people.filter(func(p) -> bool: return p.state != S.WORK and p.state != S.TEND)
	_player.place(_camp.bush.global_position + Vector3(0, 0.02, 0))
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _tutorial.stage == "hidden" and _player.hiding_in != null, 3.0)
	var went_for_him := false
	var drift := 0.0
	var was := {}
	for i in 30:
		await get_tree().physics_frame
		_watch_calm(was)
	_shot("03_hidden")
	_check("In the bush: the campers carry on, his eyes peeking, a note to wait",
		"false true true %s" % CampTutorial.HIDDEN_NOTE,
		"%s %s %s %s" % [_tutorial.frozen(), _player.hiding_in == _camp.bush, _camp.bush.peeking(), _plan.note_showing()])
	_check("In the bush: the ones who saw him are confused ('??') where they stand", "true true",
		"%s %s" % [not alarmed.is_empty(), alarmed.all(func(p) -> bool: return p.state == S.SEARCH)])

	await _until(func() -> bool: return _watch_calm(was) or _tutorial.stage == "lost", 20.0)
	_shot("04_lost")
	_check("Lost: the camera on the one who saw him, confused", "true true %s" % CampTutorial.LOST_LINE,
		"%s %s %s" % [level.camera_focus != null, _tutorial._spotter != null and _tutorial._spotter.state == S.SEARCH,
			_tutorial.spotlight.line()])
	await _until_real(func() -> bool: return _watch_calm(was) or _tutorial.stage == "calming", 6.0)
	went_for_him = was.get("went", false)
	drift = was.get("drift", 0.0)
	_check("In the bush, till they've lost him: nobody came for him, nobody moved while confused", "false true",
		"%s %s" % [went_for_him, drift < 0.1])

	# Chased right to the bush he's hidden in (set going by the check): they can't catch
	# him or shoo him out.
	var chaser: CampPerson = _camp.dancers[0]
	_camp.saw(_camp.bush.global_position)
	chaser._to_state(S.CHASE)
	var caught := false
	var came := INF
	for i in 300:
		await get_tree().physics_frame
		came = minf(came, Vector2(chaser.global_position.x - _player.global_position.x,
			chaser.global_position.z - _player.global_position.z).length())
		if chaser.state in [S.SHOO, S.TAKE] or _player.hiding_in == null:

	_check("Chased to the bush: they come right up, but can't catch him in it", "true false true",

	await _until(func() -> bool: return _tutorial.stage == "roast", 40.0)
	_check("All back at work: the camper roasting and serving, a note to sneak out",
		"true roast serve %s" % CampTutorial.SNEAK_NOTE,
		"%s %s %s" % [_calm(), " ".join(_camp.camper.routine.map(func(a: Dictionary) -> String: return a.name)),
			_plan.note_showing()])

	Input.action_press("sneak")
	Input.action_press("move_left")
	await _wait(0.1)
	Input.action_release("move_left")
	await _wait(0.5)
	_check("A move key: he hops out that way, sneaking, his eyes gone", "false false true true",
		"%s %s %s %s" % [_player.hiding_in != null, _camp.bush.peeking(), _player.sneaking,
			_player.global_position.distance_to(_camp.bush.global_position) > 0.9])
	Input.action_release("sneak")
	await _wait(0.1)
	_check("Out: the note goes, and no other words", "", _plan.note_showing())

	# Back in the bush, to watch the camper roast and serve, as a player might.
	_player.place(_camp.bush.global_position + Vector3(0, 0.02, 0))
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _tutorial.stage == "grab", 30.0)
	await _real(0.4)
	_shot("05_plate")
	_check("Served: one on the plate, the campers frozen, it's lit with no words, he's hungry", "1 true true true  hungry",
		"%s %s %s %s %s %s" % [_tutorial.roast.on_plate, _tutorial.frozen(),
			_camp.people.all(func(p) -> bool: return p.process_mode == Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED),
			_tutorial.spotlight.showing(), _tutorial.spotlight.line(), level.bubbles.showing()])
	_check("Served: no note, full speed, he can move", "%s %s false" % ["", 1.0],
		"%s %s %s" % [_plan.note_showing(), Engine.time_scale, _player.input_locked])
	await _wait(1.0)
	_check("Held: it waits for him to take it", "grab true 1", "%s %s %s" % [_tutorial.stage, _tutorial.frozen(),
		_tutorial.roast.on_plate])

	# Over to the plate, and E takes it.
	var spotted_before: float = _camp.spotted_at
	await _sneak_to(_tutorial.roast.take_from(), _tutorial.roast.plate_point())
	await _wait(0.3)
	await _press_e(RoastPlate.TAKE_TIME + 0.2)
	Input.action_release("sneak")
	await _wait(0.1)
	_check("Taken: in his mouth, off the plate", "true 0",
		"%s %s" % [_tutorial.roast.carrying(), _tutorial.roast.on_plate])
	# Since 8 Nov 2026 the caught beat waits for one of them to see him with it, in their
	# cones (the author's design). At the plate the camper may see him at once; if not yet,
	# into the camper's view.
	if _tutorial.stage != "caught":
		var eyes: Vector3 = _camp.camper.global_position
		var ahead: Vector3 = _camp.camper.global_basis.z * Vector3(1, 0, 1)
		_stand(eyes + ahead.normalized() * 2.2 + Vector3(0, 0.02, 0), eyes)

	await _until_real(func() -> bool: return _tutorial.stage == "escape", 5.0)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _camp.people.any(func(p) -> bool: return p.state == S.CHASE), 4.0)
	_shot("06_taken")
	_check("Then 'Runnn!': they come to, the camper spots him, the men chase him", "false true true",
		"%s %s %s" % [_tutorial.frozen(), _camp.spotted_at > spotted_before, _camp.people.any(func(p) -> bool: return p.state == S.CHASE)])
	# Since 11 Nov 2026 "Runnn!" sends him running back toward his tree on his own, then the
	# keys have him again; and the bush won't have him till they've given up the chase.
	var ran_from := _player.global_position
	var home := Vector2(Forest.HOME.x - ran_from.x, Forest.HOME.z - ran_from.z).normalized()
	_check("'Runnn!': he's off on his own, and the bush is closed", "true true",
		"%s %s" % [_player.running_off(), _camp.bush.closed])
	await _until(func() -> bool: return not _player.running_off(), CampTutorial.RUN_OFF + 0.5)
	var ran := Vector2(_player.global_position.x - ran_from.x, _player.global_position.z - ran_from.z)
	_check("Then the keys have him again, some way back toward his tree", "false false true",
		"%s %s %s" % [_player.running_off(), _player.input_locked, ran.dot(home) > 1.0])
	# Into the bush while they chase him: it doesn't take him; he stops at its leaves.
	await _until(func() -> bool: return not _player.is_hopping(), 3.0)
	var bush_at: Vector3 = _camp.bush.global_position
	# From outside the camp (the chasers come from inside it), facing it, for a moment:
	# without the wall he'd be through its middle by the end.
	_player.place(bush_at + Vector3(-1.6, 0.02, 0.0))
	_player.rotation.y = -PI / 2.0
	# Standing: place() keeps his speed, which would swing him round in an arc.
	_player.velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	_player.run_off(bush_at - _player.global_position, 0.7)
	# Watched the whole way: whether he ever got in or was hidden, and how near its middle.
	var run := {"in": false, "nearest": INF}
	await _until(func() -> bool:
		run.in = run.in or _player.hiding_in != null or HideSpot.is_hidden(_player)
		run.nearest = minf(run.nearest, Vector2(_player.global_position.x - bush_at.x,
			_player.global_position.z - bush_at.z).length())
		return not _player.running_off(), 1.2)
	_check("Run at the bush while they chase him: it won't have him, he stops at its leaves", "true false true",
		"%s %s %s" % [_camp.bush.closed, run.in, run.nearest > Campsite.BUSH_HIDE])
	# Away out of the camp. A chaser may be shooing him (a leap carries on wherever he's
	# put): once he's down and nobody is, away at once.
	await _until(func() -> bool: return not (_player.is_hopping()
		or _camp.people.any(func(p) -> bool: return p.state == S.SHOO)), 3.0)
	_player.place(AWAY)
	await _wait(0.2)
	await _press_e(0.1)
	_check("Running with it: he keeps it, E doesn't drop it, and he can't eat it yet", "true true false",
		"%s %s %s" % [_player.global_position.distance_to(AWAY) < 0.5, _tutorial.roast.carrying(),
			_tutorial.roast.can_eat_now()])

	# Till they've lost him and all gone back to work.
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _tutorial.roast.can_eat_now(), 40.0)
	_check("Away, once they're all back at work: the E to eat it", "true true true",
		"%s %s %s" % [_calm(), _tutorial.roast.carrying(), _tutorial.roast.can_eat_now()])
	_check("And the bush is open again", false, _camp.bush.closed)

	# Holding E, he sits up and eats it.
	var spotted_away: float = _camp.spotted_at
	var down := InputEventAction.new()
	down.action = "grab"
	down.pressed = true
	Input.parse_input_event(down)
	await _wait(RoastPlate.EAT_FOR * 0.45)
	_shot("07_eating")
	_check("Holding E: he sits up and eats it from his paws, held still", "true true true true",
		"%s %s %s %s" % [_player.model.eating, _player.snack != null and _player.snack.get_parent() == _player.model.paws,

	await _wait(RoastPlate.EAT_FOR * 0.55 + 0.2)
	var up := InputEventAction.new()
	up.action = "grab"
	up.pressed = false
	Input.parse_input_event(up)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _tutorial.step == CampTutorial.Step.TASKS, 3.0)
	_check("Eaten once they'd calmed: nobody noticed", "true WORK WORK WORK WORK",
		"%s %s" % [_camp.spotted_at == spotted_away, " ".join(_camp.people.map(func(p) -> String: return S.keys()[p.state]))])
	_shot("08_yum")
	_check("Eaten: 'Yum!', the note to press Tab, he's up, the camper's own routine back",
		"%s %s false false peg roast pizza" % [CampTutorial.YUM_LINE, CampTutorial.OPEN_NOTE],
		"%s %s %s %s %s" % [_tutorial.spotlight.line(), _plan.note_showing(), _tutorial.roast.carrying(),
			_player.model.eating, " ".join(_camp.camper.routine.map(func(a: Dictionary) -> String: return a.name))])

	_key(KEY_TAB)
	await _real(1.0)
	_shot("09_to_do")
	# Raid the bear bag joined the list on 10 Nov 2026 (camp_bear_bag.gd).
	_check("Tab: the TO DO list up to read, the camp's tasks on it, slowed",
		"true investigate party marshmallows music cooler tent bearbag true",
		"%s %s %s" % [_plan.open and _plan.up() >= 1.0,
			" ".join(level.tasks.shown().map(func(t: Dictionary) -> String: return t.id)), Engine.time_scale <= CampTutorial.SLOW + 0.01])
	_key(KEY_TAB)
	await _real(0.5)
	_check("Tab again: the world's open (list away, no note, full speed, he can move)", "DONE false  %s false" % 1.0,
		"%s %s %s %s %s" % [CampTutorial.Step.keys()[_tutorial.step], _plan.open, _plan.note_showing(), Engine.time_scale,
			_player.input_locked])
	# Since 11 Nov 2026 the marshmallow he stole counts.
	_check("And the stolen marshmallow counts: Steal the marshmallows done, written out at the bottom", "true true",
		"%s %s" % [level.tasks.is_done("marshmallows"), _plan.written("marshmallows") > 0.0])

	for music in [level._music, level._sleep_music]:
		if music:
			music.stop()
	if _camp.party:
		_camp.party.stop()
	await _wait(0.3)

# --- Watching -------------------------------------------------------------------

## Notes in `was` whether anyone has gone for him (chasing, wondering, guarding or
## shooing) and how far anyone has moved while confused, since it was first called.
## Returns false, so it can ride along in an `_until`.
func _watch_calm(was: Dictionary) -> bool:
	for person: CampPerson in _camp.people:
		if person.state in [S.CHASE, S.INVESTIGATE, S.GUARD, S.SHOO]:
			was["went"] = true
		var key := person.get_instance_id()
		if person.state == S.SEARCH:
			if not was.has(key):
				was[key] = person.global_position
			was["drift"] = maxf(was.get("drift", 0.0), person.global_position.distance_to(was[key]))
		else:
			was.erase(key)
	return false


# --- Moves ---------------------------------------------------------------------

## True while all four are calm, at work on their routines.
func _calm() -> bool:
	# Tending the fire, which the keeper does through the tutorial since 8 Nov 2026, is work.
	return _camp.people.all(func(p: CampPerson) -> bool: return p.state == S.WORK or p.state == S.TEND)


## Put at `at`, facing `look` (as tasks_test.gd's).
func _stand(at: Vector3, look: Vector3) -> void:
	var d := look - at
	_player.global_basis = Basis(Vector3.UP, atan2(-d.x, -d.z))
	_player.place(at)


func _sneak_to(at: Vector3, look: Vector3) -> void:
	Input.action_press("sneak")
	await get_tree().physics_frame
	await get_tree().physics_frame
	var d := look - at
	_player.global_basis = Basis(Vector3.UP, atan2(-d.x, -d.z))
	_player.place(at)


func _press_e(hold: float) -> void:
	var down := InputEventAction.new()
	down.action = "grab"
	down.pressed = true
	Input.parse_input_event(down)
	await _wait(maxf(hold, 0.05))
	var up := InputEventAction.new()
	up.action = "grab"
	up.pressed = false
	Input.parse_input_event(up)
	await _wait(0.05)


func _key(keycode: Key) -> void:
	for pressed: bool in [true, false]:
		var ev := InputEventKey.new()
		ev.keycode = keycode
		ev.physical_keycode = keycode
		ev.pressed = pressed
		Input.parse_input_event(ev)


## Game time.
func _wait(seconds: float) -> void:
	await get_tree().create_timer(seconds, true, true).timeout


## Real time, whatever speed the game runs at (under --fixed-fps, frames' worth).
func _real(seconds: float) -> void:
	await get_tree().create_timer(seconds, true, false, true).timeout


## Until `done`, for at most `timeout` seconds of game time.
func _until(done: Callable, timeout: float) -> void:
	var left := timeout
	while left > 0.0 and not done.call():
		await get_tree().physics_frame
		left -= get_physics_process_delta_time()


## Until `done`, for at most `timeout` seconds of real time.
func _until_real(done: Callable, timeout: float) -> void:
	var left := timeout
	while left > 0.0 and not done.call():
		await get_tree().process_frame
		left -= get_process_delta_time() / maxf(Engine.time_scale, 0.001)


func _check(name: String, expected, actual) -> void:
	var ok: bool = str(expected) == str(actual)
	_failed = _failed or not ok
	_results.append([name, str(expected), str(actual), "pass" if ok else "FAIL"])


func _shot(name: String) -> void:
	if shots == "" or DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
		return
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(shots)
	get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png(shots.path_join(name + ".png"))


func _finish() -> void:
	print("")
	print("Tutorial check, %s" % Time.get_datetime_string_from_system())
	for r: Array in _results:
		print("  %-4s  %-62s expected %-24s got %s" % [r[3], r[0], r[1], r[2]])
	print("RESULT: %s (%d checks)" % ["all checks passed" if not _failed else "SOME CHECKS FAILED", _results.size()])
	get_tree().quit(1 if _failed else 0)

extends Node
## The automated check for CHANGE-BRIEF.md's sound map. It plays a scripted input
## sequence, counts how often each sound effect starts, and compares the counts
## with the expected ones. It also checks the music's pause, mute, loop and end
## behaviour. Run it headless from the project folder:
##   godot --headless --path . -- --sound-test
## It prints a table and quits with exit code 0 if every check passes, 1 if not.

## Set by the level (main.gd).
var level: Node

var _frame := 0
var _steps := {}
var _results: Array[Array] = []
var _failed := false


func _ready() -> void:
	# Pausing is part of the test, so the test itself must keep running.
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	var player: CharacterBody3D = level.player

	# Chitter: five quick presses, then one press held down with key repeats.
	for k in 5:
		_at(10 + 4 * k, _key.bind(KEY_SPACE, true, false))
		_at(11 + 4 * k, _key.bind(KEY_SPACE, false, false))
	_at(34, _key.bind(KEY_SPACE, true, false))
	for k in 8:
		_at(36 + 2 * k, _key.bind(KEY_SPACE, true, true))
	_at(52, _key.bind(KEY_SPACE, false, false))

	# Running: a run, then Shift tapped off and on quickly while he keeps moving,
	# then a stop, then a second run.
	_at(60, func() -> void:
		Input.action_press("move_right")
		Input.action_press("run"))
	for k in 10:
		_at(120 + 4 * k, Input.action_release.bind("run"))
		_at(122 + 4 * k, Input.action_press.bind("run"))
	_at(170, func() -> void:
		Input.action_release("run")
		Input.action_release("move_right"))
	_at(200, func() -> void: player.place(level.Forest.START))
	_at(210, func() -> void:
		Input.action_press("move_right")
		Input.action_press("run"))
	_at(270, func() -> void:
		Input.action_release("run")
		Input.action_release("move_right"))

	# Climbing: onto the nearest trunk, up, cling still, then down a little.
	_at(300, func() -> void:
		player.place(level.Forest.START)
		var nearest: Dictionary = level.forest.climbable[0]
		for tree: Dictionary in level.forest.climbable:
			if tree.base.distance_to(player.global_position) < nearest.base.distance_to(player.global_position):
				nearest = tree
		player._start_climb(nearest))
	_at(320, Input.action_press.bind("move_forward"))
	_at(360, Input.action_release.bind("move_forward"))
	_at(380, Input.action_press.bind("move_back"))
	_at(395, Input.action_release.bind("move_back"))

	# A nap: from the trunk into the hollow, asleep long enough to count as a nap, with
	# two tasks ticked off while he sleeps (silently: there's no laughing in his sleep;
	# following the music is ticked off here too, as he never goes to the camp),
	# then woken, leaping out and landing.
	_at(400, func() -> void: player.rest(level.forest.rest_spot, level.forest.rest_exit))
	_at(650, func() -> void:
		level.tasks.done("investigate")
		level.tasks.done("marshmallows"))
	_at(700, _check_nap)
	_at(700, Input.action_press.bind("move_back"))
	_at(705, Input.action_release.bind("move_back"))
	_at(860, _check_awake)

	# Tasks (level 1's, camp_tasks.gd; the camp's puzzles tick them off): the others
	# ticked off in the same frame, for one laugh (the first was ticked off in his sleep).
	# Dismantle the tent, added on 8 Nov 2026, is ticked off with them, and Raid the bear
	# bag, added on 10 Nov 2026.
	_at(940, func() -> void:
		level.tasks.done("music")
		level.tasks.done("cooler")
		level.tasks.done("tent")
		level.tasks.done("bearbag"))

	# Pause and mute: switched on and off again; the game mustn't care.
	_at(1000, _check_pause_and_mute)
	# No ending yet: with every task done, the music carries on.
	_at(1280, _finish)


func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	_frame += 1
	if _steps.has(_frame):
		for step: Callable in _steps[_frame]:
			step.call()


func _at(frame: int, step: Callable) -> void:
	if not _steps.has(frame):
		_steps[frame] = []
	_steps[frame].append(step)


func _key(keycode: Key, pressed: bool, echo: bool) -> void:
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.physical_keycode = keycode
	ev.pressed = pressed
	ev.echo = echo
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)


func _check(name: String, expected, actual) -> void:
	var ok: bool = expected == actual
	_failed = _failed or not ok
	_results.append([name, str(expected), str(actual), "pass" if ok else "FAIL"])


## Asleep, the nap counted, and the task ticked off in his sleep with no laugh: the
## lullaby has taken over, and the camera is in close.
func _check_nap() -> void:
	_check("Nap: it counts as a nap", 1, level.naps)
	_check("Nap: a task done in his sleep is ticked off", true, level.tasks.is_done("marshmallows"))
	_check("Nap: no laugh in his sleep", 0, level.sound_counts.get("SFX-TASK-LAUGH", 0))
	_check("Nap: the lullaby is playing", true, level._sleep_music.playing)
	_check("Nap: the lullaby is at full level", true,
		absf(level._sleep_music.volume_db - level.SLEEP_MUSIC_DB) < 0.5)
	_check("Nap: the forest loop is faded right down", true, level._music.volume_db <= -59.0)
	_check("Nap: the camera has eased in close", 1.0, level._sleep_view)


## Woken and out of the hollow: the forest loop is back, the lullaby has stopped, and
## the nap never laughed.
func _check_awake() -> void:
	_check("Awake: he's out and on the ground", true, not level.player.resting and level.player.is_on_floor())
	_check("Awake: the lullaby has stopped", false, level._sleep_music.playing)
	_check("Awake: the forest loop is back to full", true, absf(level._music.volume_db - level.MUSIC_DB) < 0.5)
	_check("Awake: the camera is back out", 0.0, level._sleep_view)
	_check("Awake: still no laugh for it", 0, level.sound_counts.get("SFX-TASK-LAUGH", 0))


func _check_pause_and_mute() -> void:
	var music := AudioServer.get_bus_index("Music")
	var sfx := AudioServer.get_bus_index("SFX")
	level.toggle_pause()
	_check("Paused: the game stops", true, get_tree().paused)
	_check("Paused: the music is muffled", true, AudioServer.is_bus_effect_enabled(music, 0))
	_check("Paused: the music is 8 dB quieter", -8.0, AudioServer.get_bus_volume_db(music))
	level.toggle_pause()
	_check("Unpaused: the game runs", false, get_tree().paused)
	_check("Unpaused: the muffling is off", false, AudioServer.is_bus_effect_enabled(music, 0))
	_check("Unpaused: the music is back to full", 0.0, AudioServer.get_bus_volume_db(music))
	level.toggle_mute("Music")
	level.toggle_mute("SFX")
	_check("M and N: both buses muted", true, AudioServer.is_bus_mute(music) and AudioServer.is_bus_mute(sfx))
	level.toggle_mute("Music")
	level.toggle_mute("SFX")
	_check("M and N again: both unmuted", false, AudioServer.is_bus_mute(music) or AudioServer.is_bus_mute(sfx))


func _finish() -> void:
	var counts: Dictionary = level.sound_counts
	_check("SFX-CHITTER: 5 quick presses + 1 held press", 6, counts.get("SFX-CHITTER", 0))
	_check("SFX-RUN: 2 runs, Shift tapped during the first", 2, counts.get("SFX-RUN", 0))
	_check("SFX-CLIMB: 2 climbs, clinging still between", 2, counts.get("SFX-CLIMB", 0))
	_check("SFX-TASK-LAUGH: 3 tasks in a frame, not in his sleep", 1, counts.get("SFX-TASK-LAUGH", 0))
	_check("Every task done", true, level.tasks.all_done())
	_check("No ending yet: the music carries on", true, level._music.playing)
	for path: String in ["res://assets/audio/music/forest-loop.wav", "res://assets/audio/sfx/run-loop.wav", "res://assets/audio/sfx/climb-loop.wav"]:
		var s := load(path) as AudioStreamWAV
		var frames := roundi(s.get_length() * s.mix_rate)
		_check("Loop marker over the whole file: " + path.get_file(), true,
			s.loop_mode == AudioStreamWAV.LOOP_FORWARD and s.loop_begin == 0 and absi(s.loop_end - frames) <= 1)
	# The lullaby plays its opening once, then loops from where its main section repeats.
	var lullaby := load(level.SLEEP_MUSIC_PATH) as AudioStreamWAV
	var lullaby_frames := roundi(lullaby.get_length() * lullaby.mix_rate)
	_check("Loop marker from the repeat to the end: lullaby-loop.wav", true,
		lullaby.loop_mode == AudioStreamWAV.LOOP_FORWARD and lullaby.loop_begin == 1807920
		and absi(lullaby.loop_end - lullaby_frames) <= 1)

	print("")
	print("Sound check, %s" % Time.get_datetime_string_from_system())
	for r: Array in _results:
		print("  %-4s  %-52s expected %-6s got %s" % [r[3], r[0], r[1], r[2]])
	print("RESULT: %s" % ("all checks passed" if not _failed else "SOME CHECKS FAILED"))
	get_tree().quit(1 if _failed else 0)
